ops.body: Owner decision Nov12 19:22: status validates JSON syntax and all fields it consumes plus captured binding/kind/version/identity/tip. It will ignore unused lexical payload types rather than materialize or add a custom validating parser for hypothetical corrupt internal-cache fields. Full metadata writers/answer readers retain schema validation. This follows the existing instruction to optimize actual operations without edge-case machinery; no intended user-facing behavior changes. Candidate remains frozen for independent review, hosted tests then release/install and actual status measurement.
